data.description:
`docs/adr/0004:43-48` asserts the snapshot-entry shape "has a single source of truth... Both the
fetcher's output and the differs' expectations target it. When a new field is added to the
snapshot, update the schema first." Nothing enforces that.

`_engine/rebar_reconciler/_snapshot_schema.py` (228 LOC) is imported by NO production module; the
intended producer `fetcher.py` never imports it. The originating story declared
`fetcher.py (producer validates vs schema)` as file impact; that wiring never landed.

The schema encodes a `parent` present-vs-absent distinction that gates an inbound CLEAR — a
data-destroying path whose own history contains a revert titled "Revert the inbound parent clear:
it destroys data."

Refined during approval: rather than a bespoke contract test, move the contract into
`src/rebar/schemas/` where ~90 sibling schemas already live, loaded via `schemas.load()` and
validated with `jsonschema` on a `Draft202012Validator`, with a generated TypedDict layer under a
CI drift gate (`python -m rebar.schemas.gen_types`, `_build-and-test.yml:545`). The snapshot
contract is the odd one out — a hand-rolled Python module outside that machinery, which is *why*
nothing enforces it while 90 siblings are enforced automatically.

Real fetcher output exists for fixtures: `bridge_state/snapshots/` holds 548 files spanning
2026-06-11..06-29 with fully-populated entries. It is gitignored and contains PII
(`emailAddress`, `displayName`, `accountId`), so a small redacted fixture must be derived into the
tracked `tests/fixtures/jira/`, covering all three observed shapes: populated, `parent`-absent,
and horizon-trimmed-empty.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The snapshot-entry contract lives in `src/rebar/schemas/` and is loadable via `schemas.load()`
- [ ] It is covered by the existing generated-types drift gate rather than a one-off check
- [ ] A redacted fixture in `tests/fixtures/jira/` covers populated, `parent`-absent, and empty shapes
- [ ] A fetcher field change that diverges from the contract fails CI
- [ ] ADR 0004 describes the enforcement that actually exists
data.title: Enforce the snapshot-entry contract through the schemas drift gate
